Assignments.Name: Restricted Patrol Protocol
Assignments.CPUnitsRequired: RECOMMENDED: At least 3 firearm trained units (team)
Description: Escort technicians to repair any compromised containment fields or sterilizers

Respond to anti-citizen or necrotic activity
 -> Cauterize any threats to sociostability

Assignments.Name: Workforce Supervisory Detail
Description: Oversee labor detail and ensure efficient contribution from the Industrial Workforce
Ensure assets are appropriately distributed to their designated supply stock locations
OPTIONAL: If needed, establish a secure package pipeline with available CPTs

OPTIONAL: Establish a resin quota to be met by the end of the shift
 -> i.e., 3:1 resin to rations package delivery ratio until resin reaches 50% for example
OPTIONAL: Have a unit standing by at SB-7 for expediting resin deliveries

NOTE: Do not inform Industrial Workforce management of exact resin figures.
 -> Only inform them if additional resin packages are needed or not

Assignments.Name: Precinct Patrol Protocol
Description: Conduct routine patrols throughout assigned precincts
Deter unauthorized activities
Disperse any public gatherings
Investigate any nearby alarms of suspicious individuals
NOTE: Checkpoints between Precincts should be manned by at least one officer to search for POI and prevent minges from going any further

Assignments.Name: Security Checkpoint Oversight
Description: Maintain vigilance and control at security checkpoints
Conduct rigorous searches
Question any suspicious individuals about their intent to pass

Assignments.Name: Biotic Supervisory Detail
Assignments.CPUnitsRequired: RECOMMENDED: At least 1 unit per biotic
Description: Release biotic conscripts from their designated holding area to begin an assignment
Oversee labor detail, ensuring efficient contribution from all biotic conscripts
Ensure biotic conscripts are returned to their holding area upon completion

Assignments.Name: Workforce Intake Processing
Description:
Process new arrivals at WIH-3 and ensure they:
 -> Have validated their transfer with a relocation coupon
 -> Received their new ID card
 -> Do not possess contraband
Ensure citizens who possess contraband are appropriately prosecuted
NOTE: Active cities (per world-map) are: 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 24 & 27
NOTE: People saying they're from City 8 are a red-flag. It's a Combine-specific city - there are no citizens there

Assignments.Name: Conscript Custody Oversight
Description: Oversee the custody & well-being of biotic conscripts and prisoners within SB-6
Provide sustenance via dispensaries to compliant biotic conscripts and prisoners
Restrict access to areas within SB-6 by ensuring all doors are closed and locked

Assignments.Name: Surveillance Network Maintenance
Description: Utilize interfaces to monitor all active security feeds and report any criminal activity
Relay database information to local ground teams and units upon their request
